implementation.bases: Digest-pinned official Python3.12.16 and Node24.22.2 on Alpine3.24
implementation.expat: Signed local2.9.0-r100 packages with four pinned upstream security fixes and their prerequisites; retained upstream regressions/checks and honest local revision
implementation.python_xml: Original interpreter retained; pyexpat and _elementtree rebuilt with system Expat. APK-owned replacement modules replace the original independently bundled extensions through explicit symlinks.
implementation.busybox: Signed local1.37.0-r100 family; AR/CPIO/DPKG/DPKG_DEB/RPM/RPM2CPIO/TAR/UNZIP disabled in all three normalized variants. Actual post-check linker maps, unstripped symbols, applet rejection and final installed ELF binding prove identified extraction-consumer removal.
implementation.date_compatibility: A small source-pinned musl UTC-literal compatibility patch preserves the unchanged upstream date-timezone assertions; numeric offsets remain tested.
implementation.optional_code: ACL, Perl, GNU tar and dash package origins absent; pip removed after tool installation. Package absence alone is not claimed as proof of BusyBox applet absence.
implementation.authority: No candidate/evaluator authority, network, mount, permission, deadline, accounting, retry or missingness safeguard changed. Trusted BusyBox package checks alone use ordinary networking for unchanged upstream wget tests.
implementation.build: Self-contained multi-stage recipe; no undeclared prebuilt local builder dependency. Only signer public keys reach the final image; final APK installation retains default signature verification.
implementation.maintenance: Custom Expat, Python XML and BusyBox leaf builds remain. The unchanged one-line launcher does not imply a stock-image-only maintenance model.

One subsequently qualified immutable first-study image, separately presented for final owner approval; no automatic carryover to rebuilds.
Existing isolation, limits, cleanup, accounting, stop, retry and missingness rules remain unchanged.
No direct host execution or host parsing of candidate-derived XML; legacy/direct host paths excluded.
Recheck upstream before final freeze and collection.
Expire at first-study completion or new upstream trigger/fix/impact information, whichever occurs first.
Always disclose the advisory as unfixed with scoped owner acceptance, never repaired or scanner-cleared.
scoped_low_exception.resource_scope: UID/GID1001, capabilities0, NNP, one CPU-equivalent,512MiB memory/memory-plus-swap,64PIDs,16MiB scratch; evaluator deadline at most600seconds or remaining study time.
